title: The Domestication of the Fang Vanguard
causes: The collapse of advanced synapsids following the Permian-Triassic extinction event
The Asura need for resilient pack animals and war cavalry capable of carrying heavy armaments
outcomes: The selective breeding and genetic corruption of surviving Permian cynodonts and gorgonopsids
The introduction of 'Fang' draft animals through the Dwarka Gate, intensifying the war against native diapsids
summary: Fascinated by the ancestral metabolic traits of surviving synapsids, Commander Vaishura selectively breeds and weaponizes these Permian beasts, deploying them through the Dwarka Gate as cavalry against the native diapsids.
sources: Gondwana: The Asura Intervention and the Fang Wars
